column1: # Ordinary English words -- headwords of en_US.dic -- that the bundled pack does not
# contain. 6,891 are eligible; these are 200 sampled at random.
# Written `word<TAB>word`, the corpus idiom for "leave it alone". A word the pack
# lacks has no known-word guard, so the pack's own words compete for it unopposed.
# Generated by tools/make_unknown_corpus.py, seed 20260921. Sampled rather than taken in
# order: the previous edition took the first 200 of the right length, so every word
# began with "a" and the result described one corner of the alphabet.
